dedupe_keys.name: replica rooftop energy potential of low income communities in america tract level

description: REPLICA estimates residential rooftop solar technical potential for every US census tract with emphasis on low and moderate income households, and adds ten supplementary tract-level datasets on socio-demographic and market context. Technical potential is grouped by Area Median Income band, tenure (owner or renter) and building type (single-family or multi-family), based on lidar for 128 metropolitan areas, statistical modelling and American Community Survey 2011-2015 data; the model year is 2015. The core file seeds_ii_replica.csv (136.5 MB) joins to tract geometry by GEOID or GISJOIN, and archives of about 465 MB each give estimates per income band, tenure and building type. It was produced in NREL's SEEDS II (Solar Energy Evolution and Diffusion Studies) project for the 2018 technical report 'Rooftop Solar Technical Potential for Low-to-Moderate Income Households in the United States' by Ben Sigrin and Meghan Mooney, and can be explored in the Solar for All app. Coverage: United States. Access: free download (DOI 10.7799/1432837), also mirrored on OEDI. Licence: NREL data catalogue terms. Caveats: modelled estimates with a 2015 vintage. Simulation uses: equity-focused rooftop PV and community solar planning. Related records: the NREL 2016 rooftop technical potential data and the PV Rooftop Database.
